title: Poirot at SemEval-2022 Task 5 : Misogynistic Meme Detection using Early Fusion Model with Graph Network
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a machine learning model to detect misogyny in memes as part of a shared task (SemEval-2022 Task 5). While it addresses a form of social prejudice (misogyny), it does not involve the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal systems of morals and ethics.
